required.quote: The Department shall adopt rules establishing minimum requirements for continuing education and means for verification of the completion of the continuing education requirements.

available.quote: The Department may issue a license as a behavior analyst or assistant behavior analyst to an applicant licensed under the laws of another jurisdiction if the requirements for licensure in that jurisdiction are, on the date of licensure, substantially equivalent to the requirements of this Act

requirements.value: Requirements in other jurisdiction must be substantially equivalent to Illinois requirements; applicants with 10 consecutive years of licensure without discipline are exempt from submitting proof of education, professional experience, and supervision.
requirements.quote: An individual applying for licensure as a licensed behavior analyst or assistant behavior analyst who has been licensed in another United States jurisdiction for 10 consecutive years without discipline is not required to submit proof of completion of the education, professional experience, and supervision required in Section 25 or 30.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material misstatements in furnishing information to the Department, any State agency, or insurance company
disciplinary_grounds.quote: material misstatements in furnishing information to the Department or to any other State agency or in furnishing information to any insurance company with respect to a claim on behalf of a licensee or a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violations or negligent or intentional disregard of this Act or its rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violations or negligent or intentional disregard of this Act or its rules

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or a misdemeanor involving dishonesty or directly related to the practice of behavior analysis
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of or entry of a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or sentencing, including, but not limited to, convictions, preceding sentences of supervision, conditional discharge, or first offender probation, under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States that is (i) a felony or (ii) a misdemeanor, an essential element of which is dishonesty, or that is directly related to the practice of behavior analysis

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license or its renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license under this Act or in connection with applying for renewal or restoration of a license under this Act

disciplinary_grounds.quote: professional incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross negligence in practice under this Act

disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to provide information within 60 days in response to a written request made by the Department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public as defined by the rules of the Department or violating the rules of professional conduct adopted by the Department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of controlled substances, alcohol, or other substances that results in inability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs defined in law as controlled substances, of alcohol, or of any other substances that results in the inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adverse action taken by another state or jurisdiction on grounds substantially equivalent to those in this Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: adverse action taken by another state or jurisdiction if at least one of the grounds for the discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those set forth in this Section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly or indirectly giving or receiving fees or compensation for professional services not actually rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: directly or indirectly giving to or receiving from any person, firm, corporation, partnership, or association any fee, commission, rebate, or other form of compensation for any professional service not actually rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the terms of probation after license has been placed on probationary status
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a finding by the Department that the licensee, after having the license placed on probationary status, has violated the terms of probation or failed to comply with those terms

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment without cause of a client
disciplinary_grounds.quote: abandonment, without cause, of a client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing false records or reports relating to the licensee's practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully making or filing false records or reports relating to a licensee's practice, including, but not limited to, false records filed with federal or State agencies or departments

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report suspected child abuse or neglect as required by the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect as required by the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act

disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully failing to report an instance of suspected abuse, neglect, financial exploitation, or self-neglect of an eligible adult as defined in and required by the Adult Protective Services Act

disciplinary_grounds.quote: being named as an abuser in a verified report by the Department on Aging under the Adult Protective Services Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the licensee abused, neglected, or financially exploited an eligible adult

establishment_regulation_required.quote: beginning 24 months after the Department has commenced issuance of licenses under this Act, no business organization shall provide, attempt to provide, or offer to provide behavior analysis services unless every member, partner, shareholder, director, officer, holder of any other ownership interest, agent, and employee who renders applied behavior analysis services holds a currently valid license issued under this Act.

definition_quote.value: The design, implementation, and evaluation of instructional and environmental modifications to produce socially significant improvement in human behavior, including the empirical identification of functional relations between behavior and environmental factors, known as functional assessment and analysis.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of applied behavior analysis" means the design, implementation, and evaluation of instructional and environmental modifications to produce socially significant improvement in human behavior.

value: direct observation and measurement of behavior and environment
other procedures to help individuals develop new behaviors, increase or decrease existing behaviors, and elicit behaviors under specific environmental conditions
methods_authorized.quote: Applied behavior analysis interventions utilize contextual factors, motivating operations, antecedent stimuli, positive reinforcement, and other procedures to help individuals develop new behaviors, increase or decrease existing behaviors, and elicit behaviors under specific environmental conditions.

tiered_license_levels.quote: "Licensed assistant behavior analyst" means an individual licensed under this Act to engage in practice as an assistant behavior analyst under the supervision of a licensed behavior analyst or a licensed clinical psychologist.

national_certification_body.value: appropriate national certifying body as determined by rule of the Department
national_certification_body.quote: submits evidence of certification by an appropriate national certifying body as determined by rule of the Department

national_certification_required_for_lice.quote: The Department may issue a license to a certified behavior analyst seeking licensure as a licensed behavior analyst who (i) does not have the supervised experience as described in paragraph (3) of subsection (a), (ii) applies for licensure before July 1, 2028

doctoral_tier_recognized.quote: The Board shall consist of the following 5 members appointed by the Secretary: one licensed behavior analyst holding a doctoral degree

assistant_analyst_supervision_requiremen.value: A licensed assistant behavior analyst shall not engage in the practice of applied behavior analysis unless supervised by a licensed clinical psychologist or licensed behavior analyst.
assistant_analyst_supervision_requiremen.quote: An individual licensed under this Act as an assistant behavior analyst shall not engage in the practice of applied behavior analysis unless supervised by a licensed clinical psychologist or licensed behavior analyst.

supervisee_technician_exemption.quote: An individual from implementing a behavior analytic treatment plan under the extended authority, direction, and supervision of a licensed behavior analyst or licensed assistant behavior analyst.

family_member_caregiver_exemption.quote: Self-care by a patient or uncompensated care by a friend or family member who does not represent or hold oneself out to be a behavior analyst or assistant behavior analyst.

school_setting_exemption.quote: An individual with a learning behavior specialist or school support personnel endorsement from the State Board of Education, the school district in which the school is located, or a special education joint agreement serving the school district in which the school is located from delivering behavior analytic services in a school setting when employed by that school as long as those services are defined in the scope of practice for that endorsement and that person is not in any manner held out to the public as a licensed behavior analyst or licensed assistant behavior analyst.

organizational_behavior_management_exemp.quote: An individual who provides general applied behavior analysis services to organizations, so long as the services are for the benefit of the organizations and do not involve direct services to individuals.

nonhuman_animal_behaviorist_exemption.quote: An individual from performing activities that are considered to be the practice of applied behavior analysis under this Act if the activities are with nonhumans, including applied animal behaviorists and animal trainers.

researcher_educator_exemption.quote: An individual who is a matriculated student at a nationally accredited university approved in rules or a postdoctoral fellow from performing activities that are considered to be the practice of applied behavior analysis under this Act if the activities are part of a defined program of study, course, practicum, internship, or postdoctoral fellowship

scope_exclusions.quote: The practice of applied behavior analysis excludes the diagnosis of disorders, psychological testing, psychotherapy, cognitive therapy, psychoanalysis, and counseling.

prescribing_medical_diagnosis_prohibited.quote: The practice of applied behavior analysis excludes the diagnosis of disorders, psychological testing, psychotherapy, cognitive therapy, psychoanalysis, and counseling.

business_entity_license_requirement.quote: no business organization shall provide, attempt to provide, or offer to provide behavior analysis services unless every member, partner, shareholder, director, officer, holder of any other ownership interest, agent, and employee who renders applied behavior analysis services holds a currently valid license issued under this Act. No business shall be created that (i) has a stated purpose that includes behavior analysis, or (ii) practices or holds itself out as available to practice behavior analysis therapy, unless it is organized under the Professional Service Corporation Act or Professional Limited Liability Company Act.

criminal_background_check_required.quote: Each applicant for licensure as a behavior analyst shall have his or her fingerprints submitted to the Illinois State Police in an electronic format that complies with the form and manner for requesting and furnishing criminal history record information as prescribed by the Illinois State Police.

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: Each applicant for licensure as a behavior analyst shall have his or her fingerprints submitted to the Illinois State Police in an electronic format that complies with the form and manner for requesting and furnishing criminal history record information as prescribed by the Illinois State Police. These fingerprints shall be transmitted through a live scan fingerprint vendor licensed by the Department.

advisory_board_composition.value: 5 members: one licensed behavior analyst holding a doctoral degree, one licensed assistant behavior analyst, two licensed behavior analysts, and one public member
advisory_board_composition.quote: The Board shall consist of the following 5 members appointed by the Secretary: one licensed behavior analyst holding a doctoral degree, one licensed assistant behavior analyst, 2 licensed behavior analysts, and one public member.

board_includes_psychologist_member.quote: The Board shall consist of the following 5 members appointed by the Secretary: one licensed behavior analyst holding a doctoral degree, one licensed assistant behavior analyst, 2 licensed behavior analysts, and one public member.
